findings.title: Dead radar instrument
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, bottom-left radar panel
findings.problem: The radar is a solid dark circle with no sweep animation, no player blip, no range rings, and no compass. It looks like a black disc rather than a working instrument.
findings.why: In a vehicular combat game, the radar is critical for situational awareness. An empty, static radar gives no feedback and makes the UI look unfinished.
findings.fix: Add a subtle rotating sweep line, a fixed player marker at the center, range rings, and a small 'N' indicator. In practice or empty areas, show faint grid lines so the radar reads as active.

findings.title: Missing HUD in city
findings.where: City screen, entire bottom and right areas
findings.problem: The city screen shows no condition panel, radar, or speedometer, unlike the road and arena screens. Only the top bar and Arcade button remain.
findings.why: The player is still driving in the city, so the absence of critical car status (armor, tyres, speed) and situational awareness (radar) creates an inconsistent and unhelpful UI.
findings.fix: Keep the same HUD layout as the road screen in the city, or at least show the right-side condition panel and speedometer so the player can monitor the car.

findings.title: Condition panel values are unreadable
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, right-side panel
findings.problem: The 'CONDITION' section shows labels (FRONT, REAR, LEFT, RIGHT, UNDERBODY) but no visible values, and the 'TYRES' and 'PLANT & DRIVER' values are small and low contrast against the dark panel.
findings.why: The player cannot quickly assess damage or resource levels, which is essential during combat or long drives.
findings.fix: Increase the size and brightness of the values, use color-coded bars or numbers (green/yellow/red) for each condition, and add a stronger background contrast for the panel.

findings.title: Constructor preview is too small
findings.problem: The vehicle preview is a tiny dark rectangle with two vague blue squares, and the 'SUBCOMPACT - TOP VIEW' label is small and hard to read. It doesn't show armor, weapons, or wheels.
findings.why: The constructor is the core of the game's customization, but a tiny abstract preview makes it hard to understand the effect of the player's choices and reduces the feeling of building a car.
findings.fix: Enlarge the preview to take up a third of the screen and draw a clear top-down car silhouette with visible armor plates, weapon mounts, and wheels that update as components are added.

findings.title: City environment is low-contrast
findings.problem: The buildings are light gray on a gray cracked ground, so they blend together. The yellow waypoint arrows are small, and the gate circle is a thin line.
findings.why: The city reads as a flat gray texture, making it difficult to identify structures, navigate to the gate, or see the path at speed.
findings.fix: Increase the contrast between buildings and ground (e.g., darker ground or brighter buildings with outlines), make the yellow arrows larger and pulsing, and thicken the gate circle.
